# <span id="aanchor196"></span> Comparison Location

A comparison location is a type of location used to compare the measurement quantities of two entities. The entities to be compared can be meters, locations or one of each. A comparison location is typically used when a metering site has both check and custody measurement. This allows users to easily compare the two and ensure any differences fall within user-determined validation limits.

The ability for a user to define a comparison scenario provides additional capability for proactive anomaly detection. By creating a comparison location and constantly tracking the variance between the two sets of measurement points, anomalies can be promptly detected and resolved. In addition, with a history of comparisons on record, the check data can be confidently substituted if the custody measurement is unavailable.

Comparison locations calculate differences and percent differences for gas volume and gas energy; liquid GSV, NSV, summed volume, and net allowable; and mass (for both gas and liquids). The difference and percent difference is calculated for each quantity at daily, weekly, and monthly data resolutions.

## Comparison Location Editor

The Comparison Location Editor consists of a main window, a Configuration tab, and a Validation tab.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Comparison Location Editor:

Go to **Setup** \> **Location** \> **Comparison Location**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 550;height: 418;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Screen Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following items are available on the Comparison Location Editor screen:

- **Comparison** (group box) - This selector is used to pick the comparison location to be edited.

- **New** - Create a new comparison location. The fluid phase will be set to the user-defined default fluid phase configured within [User Preferences](../Settings%20Manager/User%20Settings/User%20Preferences.md). To set the fluid phase manually, click the drop-down on the **New** button and select **Gas** or **Liquid**.

  The gas and liquid fluid phases are only available with the FLOWCAL Gas and Liquid modules, respectively

- **Edit** - Enable Edit mode.

- **Cancel** - Cancel edits and do not save changes.

- **Save** - Save changes.

- **Delete** - Delete the selected location.

</div>
